name: LPSG incremental resilient scanner — overlay 3 of 6
description: Adds resumable per-page scan caching, incremental page reuse/change detection, bounded retry/backoff with Retry-After, cancellation-safe waits, cached fallback, and explicit page failure/retry state.

commit.message: feat(lpsg): make thread scanning incremental and resilient

notes: Roadmap overlay 3 of 6. Requires overlay 2 v1 as its exact source state.
Successful page scans are persisted independently, so a cancelled/interrupted scan resumes by reusing completed pages.
Fresh stable pages are reused without network fetches; the current page and newest two pages are revalidated, while stale pages are periodically revalidated.
Revalidated pages use a lightweight signature to detect unchanged versus changed content; changed/new pages are rescanned and recached.
Thread fetches retry transient network errors and HTTP 408/425/429/5xx responses with bounded exponential backoff and Retry-After support.
Retry waits and requests honor the scan AbortSignal; cancellation remains immediate and cached progress survives.
Pages that still fail after retries retain explicit failure state/page numbers and fall back to cached media when available.
Audit pass 1 fixed stale-cache revalidation/change comparison and stabilized pre-scan page signatures.
Audit pass 2 fixed failed revalidation dropping previously cached media and surfaced failed page numbers in completion status.
Audit pass 3 found no remaining promised-scope gaps; node --check and scanner contract assertions passed.
